sql: SELECT a.id, (SELECT MAX(b.v) FROM (VALUES (1, 10), (1, 20), (2, 30)) AS b(id, v) WHERE b.id = a.id) AS max_v FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) AS a(id) ORDER BY a.id
SELECT a.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (VALUES (1), (1), (2)) AS b(id) WHERE b.id = a.id) AS n FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) AS a(id) ORDER BY a.id
